summary_1line: After Satyaki and Karna gain new chariots, Bhima complains of Karna’s insults and urges Arjuna, who vows vengeance for Abhimanyu and threatens Karna’s line.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima, weapon in hand and burning with rage, speaks to Arjuna on the battlefield while the armies clash around them.
Arjuna confronts Karna amid the dust of battle, raising his weapon and vowing to slay Vrishasena before his father's eyes.
As the sun dims and sinks toward the Asta hill, Krishna stands beside Arjuna in the chariot, praising his terrible prowess amid the fading light of war.
